pr.title: fix(conport): gate auto-fork write side-effect behind ?auto_fork=true on GET
pr.body:
Fixes a correctness bug where `GET /api/progress` on an empty workspace silently creates rows via auto-fork, violating GET idempotency.

Changes:
1. In enhanced_server.py `_get_progress` (~line 911): reads `auto_fork` query param (default `false`); reads env `DOPEMUX_AUTO_FORK_PROGRESS` as fallback default; only forks when either is truthy.
2. Updates services/dcp-readonly-facade/src/dcp_facade/conport.py to ensure the facade caller never passes ?auto_fork=true.

Acceptance: plain `GET /api/progress` on empty workspace creates 0 rows; `GET /api/progress?auto_fork=true` forks as before.
